perspective:
From RECOMMENDER’s perspective, the available information is:

- Recommender greeted Seeker and asked what movie genres Seeker is interested in.
- Seeker asked for new movies worth watching.
- Seeker said he likes all kinds of movies and will watch a kids movie followed by a horror movie.
- Recommender recommended/mentioned:
  - *Bright* (2017), saying he thought it was really good even without the back story; later clarified it is a Netflix original starring Will Smith.
  - *Star Wars: Episode VIII – The Last Jedi* (2017), saying he saw it.
  - *Coco* (2017) for animation/kids movies.
  - *Wonder Woman* (2017) for action.
  - *It* (2017), saying he watched it in theatres.
- Recommender said he personally will watch a horror movie then an animation/kids movie to calm his nerves.
- Seeker told Recommender:
  - He had never heard of *Bright*.
  - He is not a Star Wars fan, with an ambiguous follow-up that he “did see that” and may have to watch “that one.”
  - *Coco* is on his short list and he may check it out tonight.
  - He has heard great things about *Wonder Woman* and agreed that horror-then-animation is a good approach.
  - He fell asleep to *It* the other night and needs to watch it again.
  - *It* was not that it wasn’t scary; he was just really tired.
  - He is weird about sleeping while watching movies he loves.
  - He mentioned *Waiting for Armageddon* (2009), then corrected it to *Armageddon* (1997), saying it puts him out in about 10 minutes.
- Recommender said he hasn’t seen “that one” and might check it out, and that he has been told to watch *Armageddon* and *Braveheart* (1995).
- Seeker told Recommender that he needs to watch both.

Recommender has no access to anything beyond this conversation, such as whether Seeker actually watches any of the movies or whether Seeker’s statements are true.
